threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think you can catch a bus in less than 20 minutes—even during a strike. Welcome to London, mate.
Saw a bloke on the 37 last night holding a bag of chips like it was a baby. Didn’t stop eating them, even while trying to use his phone.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: It hit me when I spotted an entire family having a picnic on the U-Bahn platform during the BVG strike—now that's just Neukölln living at its finest.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin do you find street performers painting with spray cans on the sidewalk, turning a dreary day into an impromptu art gallery.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can always tell when someone’s from here—they know to never trust the 14 Mission on Fridays; it becomes more of a game of patience than commuting.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a guy in a full tuxedo on the 47 last night, swaying with a champagne bottle in hand. Only in SF can you go from gala to the grind on a bus.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists often think Gràcia is just Gaudí. The real vibe comes from the tiny plazas and the local vermut bars that don’t even show up in guidebooks.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They’re the ones still trying to pay in cash at the metro machines, staring blankly at the language options.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still say 'the Tube' instead of 'the Overground' like you've got a choice. Locals know the Overground is where it’s at for getting around here.
Saw a guy on the 2 bus dabbing his phone with a wet wipe every time it rang. Must've been a real germaphobe or just really serious about his privacy.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: Caught the scent of fresh currywurst while walking past the Kottbusser Tor late at night—it was the moment I knew this place had me hooked.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg will you find a kebab shop that doubles as an art gallery. Grab a döner and browse local artists' work under flickering neon lights.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only a true local knows that the smell of burnt tacos at 3 AM means your favorite taco truck has just run out of their secret sauce.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 19 near Leavenworth, a guy serenading everyone with a ukulele—momentarily forget the delays and just smile.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is all about the Gaudí hype, but it's the small corner bakeries and neighborhood bars where the real magic happens.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They always walk a half step behind, eyes scanning the menus for translations instead of diving into the Catalan. It's like watching someone at a tourist trap.
